review_explanation: Salesforce APIs document OAuth-based authentication.
Salesforce REST and SOAP APIs are documented; ignore unsupported WebSocket/gRPC from second pass.
Zoho CRM v8 documents a REST API.
Official CRM API covers metadata, records, bulk, queries and other capabilities; qualitative breadth judgment.
Zoho officially documents pre-built CRM MCP servers capable of CRM operations.
API key is used as username in HTTP Basic authentication (key:X).
Official Inbox API documents OAuth2; webhook-signature HMAC does not authenticate to its REST API.
Inbox API is HTTPS REST; webhooks are distinct from WebSocket.
Gladly API explicitly specifies token-based HTTP Basic authentication.
Official Zoho Cliq API uses OAuth2.
Official Zoho Cliq v3 documentation describes REST API.
Zoho documents its own MCP server with Cliq tools.
Google Ads API supports REST and gRPC transports. WebSocket in supplied final value is unsupported.
Official Marketing MCP indexes documentation, not merchant account actions; distinguish transactional MCP.
Airtable web API is RESTful; an SDK is available, but WebSocket was not established.
Jira Cloud REST supports OAuth2 and Basic using email + API token; exact bearer/PAT taxonomy requires nuance.
Jira Cloud REST v3 exists; Forge CLI is an additional tooling surface.
Jira REST v3 exposes extensive resources and operations; breadth is analyst judgment.
monday.com core platform API is GraphQL, not a standard REST resources API; do not count transport over HTTP as REST.
Developer account, app registration, and sandbox instructions are self-service; distinguish production/account access from sandbox.
QuickBooks Online accounting API has a documented REST interface. The broader Intuit documentation also references GraphQL; REST is the minimum confirmed interface.
